name: Giant’s Limbs
body:
Like your prodigious jaw, you’ve got lengthy limbs too—so long they are almost disproportional to your already enormous body.

Prerequisite(s) Jötunfolk, character level 5th, Fleet, Giant’s Jaw

Benefit(s) Your reach increases to 10 ft.

Normal Jötunfolk have a reach of 5 feet.
